audit.notes: The new blocks comprehensively cover all scientifically useful content from the old draft, including mechanisms (superposition, interferometry, resonators), performance boundaries (inference vs. training latency, hybrid DANTE approach), co-design strategies (inverse design, PINNs, surrogates), specific demonstrations (MedMNIST accuracy, power splitter correlation), and open questions (system-level benchmarks, memory integration). No unique scientific claims, quantified results, or boundary conditions present in the old draft are missing in the new blocks.
